summary: Patriot National Bancorp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into subordinated note purchase agreements on September 18, 2026, issuing $10.0 million of 8.5% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due September 30, 2036. Interest is fixed at 8.5% semiannually through September 30, 2031, then resets quarterly at three-month SOFR plus 416 basis points. Notes are unsecured, subordinated, non-convertible, and intended as Tier 2 capital; redemption is permitted on or after September 30, 2031, subject to regulatory approval. Performance Trust Capital Partners was sole placement agent. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
